iboxs31_aht20_init.tooltip: Initialize the onboard AHT20 (I2C 0x38, SDA=IO0 SCL=IO1); put it in setup

iboxs31_aht20_read.tooltip: Temperature (°C) or relative humidity (%). A measurement takes about 80 ms; reads within 0.5 s reuse the last result

iboxs31_aht20_ok.tooltip: Whether the latest measurement succeeded; false when the sensor is missing, busy or fails the CRC, and the last good values are kept
